data.title: Myanmar human rights conditions at new low, UN says
data.description: GENEVA - Human rights conditions in Myanmar have ‌sunk to a new low, with widespread abuses against the Rohingya minority and a booming illicit economy driven partly by illegal rare-earth mining deepening civilian suffering, the United Nations said on Tuesday.

data.title: Canada ready to respond to Trump’s steep tariffs
data.description: Canada is preparing to announce its answer to US President Donald Trump's latest wave of tariffs on Tuesday, as a trade war intensifies between the historically close allies

data.title: Europe’s biggest gaming show eyes ‘Grand Theft’ boost
data.description: COLOGNE, Germany - Europe’s biggest video games show Gamescom opens its doors on Tuesday in Cologne with the industry hoping that the coming blockbuster “Grand Theft Auto VI” can provide a much-needed boost, as studios cut jobs amid fierce competition.

data.title: UN: One million Afghan children face ‘life-threatening’ malnutrition
data.description: GENEVA - One million children in Afghanistan are suffering from life-threatening malnutrition in a worsening new crisis hitting the country, the United Nations warned on Tuesday.

data.title: West Bank settlers attack AFP journalists
data.description: JANNATAH, Palestinian Territories - Israeli settlers in the West Bank on Tuesday attacked AFP journalists reporting on tension with Palestinians, in violence that left at least five people injured, the reporters and medics said.

data.title: World urged to rein in ‘killer robots’
data.description: GENEVA - The United Nations and the Red Cross warned Tuesday that the world is “dangerously close” to a future where so-called “killer robots” could target humans, and issued an urgent appeal for international regulation of autonomous weapons.

data.title: National Science and Technology Fair 2026 Opens a World of Innovation from 8 Countries
data.description: The National Science and Technology Fair 2026 is alive with excitement and discovery. In one area, a child wears a brainwave-sensing device and concentratesto sendcommands that make a robot move. Nearby, children build with LEGO, writecodeand learn to control robots themselves. Elsewhere, visitors can get hands-on with aviation technology, space science,agricultureand virtual reality.

data.title: Pheu Thai candidate wins Kalasin PAO election
data.description: KALASIN - Pheu Thai candidate Chalermkwan Lottrakul has been elected president of the Kalasin Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) by a landslide, receiving 306,674 votes, according to unofficial results.

data.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to dock in Thailand next week
data.description: ⁠The ​aircraft carrier USS ​Abraham Lincoln is expected to dock in Thailand next week, following a prolonged deployment in the Middle East that raised concerns about conditions aboard the US Navy ship.

data.title: THAI says typhoon could disrupt Taipei, Shanghai flights
data.description: Thai Airways International has advised passengers on flights to Taipei and Shanghai on Thursday and Friday to check schedules as they could be disrupted by an approaching storm.

data.title: Lockerbie bombing trial delayed over ‘new evidence’
data.description: WASHINGTON - A US federal judge has postponed the trial of a Libyan man accused of making the bomb that destroyed a Pan Am flight over Scotland in 1988, killing 270 people, citing new evidence.

data.title: ‘Traumatic’ tornado shatters French village
data.description: POMAS, France - Two people were in critical condition and thousands of households were without power on Tuesday after a “tornado of severe intensity” wreaked havoc in southern France, officials said.

data.title: Palestine flag in Phuket shop angers Israelis
data.description: PHUKET - An argument between a mobile phone shop owner and two Israeli tourists over a “Free Palestine” flag has drawn attention after video of the exchange was posted on social media.

data.title: Visas revoked for threats to Samui zoo owner
data.description: The visas of foreigners who threatened the life of a private-zoo owner on Koh Samui have been revoked, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said on Tuesday.

data.title: Cabinet backs wider SEC powers in capital-market overhaul
data.description: Four amendment bills would update electronic processes, secondary markets, fundraising and audit oversight, but still require parliamentary approval.

data.title: Acquittal overturned, Prinn gets 3 years for indecent assault
data.description: The Court of Appeal has overturned the acquittal of former Democrat Party deputy leader Prinn Panitchpakdi and sentenced him to three years in prison for indecent assault and taking a minor away from parental care for indecent purposes.
